name: Asahina Kyouko
source:
"I have one foot in the grave, you see."

[url=https://vndb.org/c45359]Makoto's[/url] classmate, and a shrine maiden at the town's shrine. She has a sixth sense and can see ghosts, but this has made her develop a complex towards interacting with living humans. [url=https://vndb.org/c45359]Makoto's[/url] arrival has given her an opportunity to try to improve her poor social skills.


Special skills: Conveniently pretending she didn't hear things
Hobbies: Spacing out
Likes: Blue skies, her few friends, cute stationery
Dislikes: Ghosts, conversation (she's bad at it), the cold

[Based on translation from the [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/amatsutsumi/#prettyPhoto]Developer's Site[/url]]
